Name: Hiroshi - Custom NPC
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
She appears out of nowhere...

﻿Satoshi Kamura is a renowned Super-Model working from an agency from Zuzu city.  She seems different from other people you met, she's a bit tall and well shaped with a hint of wisdom that puts off the stereotypical Model.  She is extremely gentle to everyone she meets and can find the beauty hiding behind any visage.  She seems to enjoy Bars, Taverns, Saloons, and Clubs, wishing to go to any prestigious party in the world.  Yet..... why is she here? 

Hiroshi is a Custom NPC with built in response to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2898]Razolyn the Magnificent[/url]﻿. Once her true Identity is revealed she will reward the farmer with two prizes:

[list]
[*][b]Links your home to Harem:[/b] Upon upgrading your home(or if you have upgraded already), Hiroshi will link a bar and spa to the farmhouse using her pocket dimension Harem.  (This can be disabled if you have your own custom farmhouse.)
[*][b]Lustbringer Beam Saber:[/b] After becoming a good friend of Hiroshi and completing Mr. Qi's skull cavern challenge, the next day Hiroshi will give you her goddess weapon to help you go deeper within the depths of the cavern. 
[/list]
[b]Hiroshi will not appear until you have 2 hearts with either all bachelors (Elliott, Alex, Shane, Sebastian, Harvey, Sam) or all bachelorettes (Abigail, Haley, Emily, Leah, Maru, Penny) There is no combination requirement for now as there was a limitation. She was not meant to show up immediately as she unlocks endgame rewards.[/b] 

1.2.0 Notes:
[list]
[*]Added dialogue for compatibility for Unique Responses.
[/list]
1.1.0 Notes:
[list]
[*]Added ConfigSchema:  Run the game once and then go to Hiroshi's folder.  Use a text editor to set [i]"Allow Harem": [/i]to either [b]true [/b]or [b]false[/b].  This is useful if you have a farmhouse that you'd rather use.
[/list]1.0.0 Official Release Notes:
[list]
[*]Harem added as a reward.  Changes the Farmhouse upgrade 2 and beyond with a Bar and Spa.
[*]Lustbringer Beam Saber.  This is given to you by Hiroshi when you complete Mr.Qi's 25 floor challenge.  Must also be at least 8 hearts with Hiroshi and Have her revealed as Hiroshi.
[/list]
The Iridium tree asset was graciously allowed by Max Vollmer a.k.a. SDVProtector creator of the Deep Woods mod which can be found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571

[*][b]New Portraits: [/b]3 new portraits for when Hiroshi is in her swim-suit.

0.0.2 Notes:

[list]
[*][b]Added Gift Tastes!![/b] You should have a larger interaction with Hiroshi now. 
[*][b]Conditional Appearance!! [/b]Will not appear until you have 2 hearts on either all the marriagable girls or boys (no combination). [i]Will appear the day after a short event at the bus stop![/i]

[i]Be advised that sometimes Hiroshi won't go anywhere her first appearance.  There is nothing I can do about that at this time.  She will start moving the following day, I have confirmed this.. Tools that advance time may mess that up.[/i]
